svg.text: every step is one stashui command
“Build a landing page: header, hero, features, pricing. Dark and calm.”
Reads your stack, tokens and the components you already have.
Describe it in words. Matches come back as a picture.
a numbered grid, a line per number
Looks closer at its top two before choosing.
hover, click, scroll in one still
Sees every pick together, the way you will.
does this look like one product?
One shadcn command installs the whole screen.
yours to edit, no runtime package
Checks the code it wrote. Every FAIL row gets fixed.
ONLY IF YOU ASK FOR A MOCKUP
A page with each pick playing beside its runners-up. Swap any, then approve.
The report lists every pick with its runner-up, so you know what else was on the table.
